name: hovercard3

frames.best_why: The hover overlay is fully shown with the 'Who we are' heading, bio and Learn More button.

tagline: Portrait card turns into a red bio panel with a button on hover.
summary: A tall portrait card shows a man's photo with his name and role along the bottom; hovering swaps the image for a flat red-orange bio panel with a short paragraph and Learn More button.
appearance: A tall rectangular card holds a portrait of a smiling man against a plain grey studio wall. A red-orange band at the bottom carries his name in bold white and 'CEO & Design Engineer' beneath it.
behaviour: Hovering fades the photo out beneath a solid red-orange panel that slides its content up, swapping name and role for a 'Who we are' heading, a short paragraph and a black Learn More button; leaving restores the portrait.
demo_content: Portrait of 'Naymur Rahman, CEO & Design Engineer'; hover panel reads 'Who we are'.
search_phrases: profile card with photo and name
portrait card reveals bio on hover
photo that turns into text panel
employee card with learn more button
use_when: An about or team page wants compact people cards that give a short bio on hover.
avoid_when: Touch and keyboard users never trigger the bio, since the reveal is hover-only on a plain div.
customise: The photo, name, role, bio paragraph and button are hardcoded, as are the red-orange palette and 400x450 size; all changes need a source edit.
weight_why: One photo and CSS opacity transitions on two overlay panels.

a11y.note: Bio and button sit behind a hover-only overlay on a non-focusable div, so keyboard users cannot reach them; alt text says 'shoes' for a portrait.

issues: Alt text 'shoes' does not match the portrait photo.
The bio panel and Learn More button are unreachable without a mouse.
polish_why: Bold colour block and clean type; the hover-only reveal and wrong alt text hold it back.
title: Profile Hover Card
